tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rnam sras gtor bsngo bsod nams g.yang 'phel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /gdul bya 'dul phyir gnod sbyin dbang / /lcang lo can bzhugs rgyal chen la/ /gus btud de yi gtor bsngo bshad/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi gtor bsngo bsdus pa rgyun gyi nyams len bya tshul ni/ snod gtsang mar bku bag dang ma 'dres pa'i zlum gtor dkar po che ba gcig la chung ba brgyad kyis bskor ba chu gtsang mas sbyangs/ sa lo'i phyag bzhes rgyun gyi gtor ma dang sbrel nas byed tshe dur khrod bdag po'i gtor bsngo'i rjes su gong gi gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar khaṃ dkar po zhu ba las byung ba'i lha'i zhal zas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rang gi mdun du bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i pho brang sum brtsegs su gnas pa'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ seṃ las seng ge dkar mo rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i steng du bai yig ser po las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras ser po g.yas nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur/ phyi'i 'khor sa dang po'i phyogs mtshams kyi khang brtsegs brgyad du/ shar du rmugs 'dzin ser po g.yas rin po che/ lhor gang ba bzang po ser po g.yas bum pa/ nub tu nor bu bzang po dkar po g.yas nor bu/ byang du ku bai ra nag po g.yas ral gri/ shar lhor yang dag shes ser po g.yas gser gyi gri/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas nag po g.yas rin po che'i mdung / nub byang du lnga rtsen ser skya g.yas khang brtsegs/

byang shar du 'jam po 'khyil pa dkar po g.yas ral gri phub/ thams cad kyi g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la chibs pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ 'khor sa bar pa la gnod sbyin bye ba/ 'khor sa tha ma la sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas lcang lo can nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med pas thim/ rin po che'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bai shā ma ṇa ya sa pā ri wā ra prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ añtsa ma naṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ de nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ bai shra ma na ye/ oṃ dzam+bha la ye/ oṃ purna bhā tra ye/ oṃ ma ṇi bhā dra ye/ oṃ ku bai ra ye/ oṃ saṃ pra dzña na ye/ oṃ gu h+ya thā na ye/ oṃ pañtsi ka ye/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ye sa pa ri wa ra i daṃ bha liṃ gṛh+nan tu ma ma sarba sidhi me pra yats+tshan+tu ma ma sarba karma swa dha a mo gha swāhā/ lan gsum/ oṃ bai shā ma ṇa ye prok+ṣa ṇaṃ/ sogs gong bzhin mchod/ thal mo sbyar la/ rgyal chen rnam thos sras yab yum sras blon 'bangs dang bcas pa rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bla ma'i sku tshe srings/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa nye bar zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams sogs dkyus 'gre/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/

hūm̐/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i gdan steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal bsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang / /khyad par las sgrub rta bdag brgyad/ /nor ster ba yi klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang / /'byor pa'i longs spyod phun tshogs zhing / /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /gzhan don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /de nas pu tra'i gtor bsngo sogs/ yang 'di rang zur du byed na phyag rdor lta bu'i bdag bskyed sngon 'gro dngos gzhi gong bzhin la/ 'dod gsol gyi mthar yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang / sogs kyi nongs pa bzod gsol/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa rang la thim/ sogs rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ sogs/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i/ sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brten par bya'o// //'di yang mthu stobs ye shes kyi kha bton du sa skya pa kun blos sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ rnam sras gtor bsngo bsod nams g.yang 'phel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
